policy: Unmodified published peer, default z, masked temperature 0.55
heads: Frozen D-152 69-dimensional head, data-matched retrained 69-dimensional head, and same-budget head augmented by 24 train-only principal components each from global, board and hand contextual tokens.
rank_gate: Paired per-game mean rank NLL improvement with bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero against both controls on 512 untouched seeds; expected utility MSE must not rise against the data-matched control.
fork_gate: At T8-T12 fork on the original peer opening. Invest in an upgrade or available scaling component versus buy the strongest available non-core body. Score the next public decision after the specified purchase or upgrade, averaged over two planning futures. Validate tempo using first-turn end-of-recruit body in those separate futures. On verified tradeoffs (tempo has greater mean body), require >=60 states, >=15 head disagreements and paired selected terminal utility advantage 95% lower bound >0 against data-matched baseline and positive advantage against frozen D-152. All eligible states also reported. No fitting on continuation labels.
ppo: Only if both gates pass: start both arms at original actor, same sampling stream and D-152 budget of 60 batches x 256 games, single seed; then independently evaluate both endpoints and unchanged peer on 512 fresh paired seeds. No overnight submission.
